name: Tieto Oyj
summary: Tieto Oyj operates as a software and digital engineering company in Norway, Sweden, Finland, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Tieto Tech Consulting, Tieto Banktech, Tieto Caretech, and Tieto Indtech Services. The Tieto Tech Consulting segment provides business advisory and design, data engineering, and other software research and development services. The Tieto Banktech segment offers Banking-as-a-Service platform and software products for payments, cards, wealth management, financial crime prevention, and credit domains.
